verdict.rationale: Pulley documents its own fundraising-modeling product, which produces a pro-forma for a next priced round or SAFE, runs pre-financing and post-financing scenarios, and lets founders explore the impact of their choices. That covers the core modeling and pro-forma ownership parts of the story, but nothing shows the scenario can be shared with counsel or investors (the Excel download covers the cap table, not a scenario). missing for 10: explicit option pool top-up modeling, documented SAFE conversion mechanics in round models, scenario sharing with counsel and investors, in-depth help docs and independent or hands-on corroboration.
